column5: GROUP: Across crates: | 1. **Match-pattern dependencies**, 3 copies: `SRT/values.rs:2510`, `ST/values_and_types.rs:1503`, `TT/values.rs:3062`. Opened all three: same job. SRT and typed-trees pass `HandleSpan::empty()` for a destructure pattern's fields (so field `Equal` values are never listed) and use `condition`; the syntax-trees copy lists the fields and uses `guard`. Both SRT and typed-trees pattern structs do have a `fields` member (`SRT/values.rs:3301`, `TT/values.rs:4881`). 23 call sites in other crates; receiver type per call not resolved (unit 079).
